text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 4, 2025) for 114 Barrington Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 4, 2025) for 114 Barrington Avenue, Folder Number: 25 218224 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to August 31, 2026.
